children: U.S. cinema advertising platform's Q3 revenue fell 3.2% yr/yr, missing analyst expectations
Company posted larger net loss and operating loss compared to prior year
Company completed Captivate acquisition, expanding digital screen network
Company expects Q4 2026 revenue of $117.0 mln to $124.0 mln
Company sees Q4 2026 Adjusted OIBDA between $42.0 mln and $48.0 mln
CINEMA ADVERTISING DECLINE - Co reported lower cinema advertising revenue, contributing to overall revenue decrease
HIGHER OPERATING COSTS - Increased theater exhibition fees and administrative costs contributed to wider operating loss
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advertising & marketing peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for National Cinemedia Inc is $4.25, about 156% above its November 9 closing price of $1.66
The stock recently traded at 56 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 119 three months ago
